note: Randomized run schedule. Each session holds one instance of every base profile, so no two clones of the same profile are ever scored in the same session. protocol: The full design: every clone under both disclosure conditions. VI-SPDAT is scored over all of it. The AI arm uses the smaller paste schedule in data/ai/paste_schedule.json.
